_doc: North Haven Private Income Fund LLC anchor proposal for 2026-03-31 A2 bundle. Keeps the existing production section/rate/date anchors and adds only a narrow terminal TRANCHE marker for bare issuer fragments such as 'Associations, Inc. 1'. This does not infer SOI columns or rate fields; it only prevents issuer-plus-index identifiers from landing in an empty signature.

anchors.label: CASH
anchors.regex: money market|government fund|financial square|u\.?s\.? government|liquidity (?:fund|funds)|cash and cash equivalent

anchors.label: DEBT
anchors.regex: first lien debt|second lien debt|senior secured|subordinated debt|debt investments?|unsecured debt

anchors.label: EQUITY
anchors.regex: common equity|preferred equity|equity interest|membership interest|llc interest|preferred stock|common stock|warrant|equity investments?
